trap.label: narrativa no passado
trap.wrong: So I broke it down and I am solving the problem.
trap.right: So I broke it down and solved the problem.
trap.why: O brasileiro mistura presente e passado ao contar histórias. Em inglês, mantenha o passado na narrativa.

mcq.q: I’d like to talk about a time ___ I led a team.
The problem ___ that we had no time.

fix.wrong: The problem were that we had no time.
fix.right: The problem was that we had no time.

fix.wrong: So I breaked it into steps.
fix.right: So I broke it into steps.

rewrite.prompt: Passado: “I break the task into steps.”
rewrite.answer: I broke the task into steps.

rewrite.prompt: Passado: “The problem is that we have no time.”
rewrite.answer: The problem was that we had no time.
